issues.on_page: Reclassifications column p6-7: Student transportation (103,066), State categorical programs (58,726), Federal programs (251,792), Instruction +303,391; net (110,193)
issues.issue: [fixed] The hidden-transfer contra line (-110,193, label 'Contra: transfers hidden in spending lines') is put in support services, but none of the reclassified lines are support services. The combining schedule shows 103,066 coming out of Student transportation (General 541,321 to Total 438,255) and the other 7,127 out of the state categorical and federal programs group, which the reclassification moves into Instruction (58,726 + 251,792 - 303,391 = 7,127). As recorded, support services detail is understated by 110,193 against the statement, and student transportation is overstated by 103,066 and instruction by 7,127. It should be a student transportation contra of -103,066 and an instruction contra of -7,127 (or one contra in student transportation with review). Amount and other financing offset are correct.

Kept as other with review. By fund it is: General Fund 26,878 (sale of property 8,832 + other nonrevenue receipts 18,046, p9), Special Building 164 (other local receipts), and Other Governmental 2,860 (School Nutrition other 2,405 + Bond other local 147 + QCPU other local 27 + QCPU public power district taxes 281). No category is more than half, so other is defensible; it is listed for review.

State sources includes nameplate capacity tax of 8,831 (6,733 + 926 + 1,039 + 133, from the fund schedules; also printed as 'Nameplate capacity 8,831' on p2), which is other taxes under the rules. It was kept as one broad line, which is acceptable because the statement line has no breakdown of its own; this is a note only.
